text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone! Follow along! Follow this 
Queen!

No matter what position Daring Heart was 
in, she aggressively probed forward, 
almost as if she were the one leading the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Heart~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah~~! —As expected of Heart, that 
was an awesome run!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-chan, you're the absolute best~♡ 
Here's a hearty heart from Pandora-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyooone!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Mmm, mwah! ♡

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah~~~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—But... I can't be getting out of breath 
over this.

Daring Heart ran magnificently on the 
grand stage of her Make Debut. While many 
girls freeze up in fear, her mental 
fortitude truly shone through...
choice_data_list:
(As expected from someone from a 
prestigious club.)

(As expected from someone from a 
prestigious club, huh.)

text_block_list.text:
And I hear she was quite the elite, even 
within the Hilesta Academy. With this, in 
the graded races ahead—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Nah, a Graded race is gonna be tough for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, ya think so? I thought Daring Heart 
ran pretty darn well, though. Plus... 
she's, like, super flashy.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Take a good look, yeah? Her build looks 
frail. And in graded stakes, there'll be 
plenty of girls with strong physicals... 
so, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So then, how was it? My Make Debut!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all? Aren't you going to send 
me a heart sign too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just kidding! Well, now that you've 
safely finished your Make Debut...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait any longer! Let's decide 
on our next target race! What's your plan?

"...The conversation with the reporter 
earlier crosses my mind. While their 
phrasing bothers me, it's true that 
building more physical strength is 
necessary."
choice_data_list:
(I should probably prioritize training 
during the Junior Year.)

text_block_list.text:
From here on, the Twinkle Series will only 
get fiercer. Before diving into that, we 
should start by gaining some experience in 
Open races.
choice_data_list:
Our long-term goal is in the Classic year, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Stop! ...I can read your mind."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Building up my body through training while 
running in races that aren't too 
strenuous... Something like that, I 
suppose?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not happening! Trainer, what I need to 
take on next is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies! It has to be 
this!

The Hanshin JF is a Junior-class GⅠ race. 
It gathers the girls who possess the 
utmost raw aptitude and talent— the 
greatest power at this stage, while their 
bodies and skills are still developing.
choice_data_list:
(This is an important race that will lead 
to what's ahead, but...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's still too advanced for me"... You 
look like you want to say that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I know. But... You know what my dream is, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Next year's Tiara circuit won't wait for 
us. We need to make our presence known 
before then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"No one will clash against me with a fiery 
heart. Don't you agree?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Heart belongs on the Tiara path"! "And 
heart is my greatest rival"! —I want to 
bring raw passion to my dream stage!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show you I can get way, way 
stronger in time for the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —You'll help me out, won't you? Of course!

Pushed by the serious look in her eyes, I 
think. Taking on high-level challenges 
will undoubtedly elevate her current 
ability. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Nice to meet you!"
choice_data_list:
(Now it's just a matter of whether it can 
be delivered in time...)

text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ah! Heart-chan, welcome baaack~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Listen! We all grabbed Kyoto udon on the 
way back, and the white miso was seriously 
so sweet and yummy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that sounds lovelyâª I should 
have done some sightseeing before heading 
back too!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Hmmm~? Heart-chan, aren't you 
looking kinda grim?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You can be weirdly sharp sometimes. I'm 
not being stingy or anything. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Not yet!! I'm going to win this...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet. It's just... still nowhere near 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Compared to her... it's not even close.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—I have to change. In order to... become 
even stronger.
